# borgbackup

## Files

- repos.nix
- default.nix

## File Summaries

### repos.nix
BorgWarehouse repository names for every backed-up host, shared by the NixOS borg-client module and the nixable (Bazzite) playbooks.

### default.nix
NixOS BorgBackup client for BorgWarehouse, enabled via the "borg-client" hostRole; backs up /home with a per-host sops key + passphrase.

## Overview

This folder contains the following files with their respective purposes summarized above.
